messages:
anya: quick async check — doing a short triage on SDK examples + quickstarts today. drop 1-2 line status + any blockers. goal: ship the sampleapp doc fixes + one lint-only PR by EOD :hourglass: 

matt: working on the sampleapp README rewrite, pushed a draft PR (https://github.com/redwood-inference/sampleapp/pull/312). main blocker is the code snippet for auth — need confirmation on the minimal env vars. cc @anya

jess: CI flake on node ESM sample — tests pass locally but GH actions consistently times out on macOS runners. opened https://github.com/redwood-inference/sampleapp/pull/311 to skip the flaky test for now. rerun helped once.

sam: docs site build error when mkdocs renders the examples page, traceback points to our mkdocs plugin for code-tabs. stack: 
```
TypeError: 'NoneType' object is not iterable
  at plugin.render_tabs (/workspace/docs/plugins/code_tabs.py:42)
```
I can take this after lunch. probable quick fix: guard for empty metadata.

anya: thanks — matt, can you paste the env var list here? want to include it in the quickstart snippet. jess — which test is flaky? just the integration one?

matt: env vars: REDWOOD_API_KEY, REDWOOD_MODEL=redwood-v1, REDWOOD_REGION=us-west-2. I'll add a note about optional local dev tokens. snippet I'll add: ```bash
export REDWOOD_API_KEY=sk_xxx
export REDWOOD_MODEL=redwood-v1
```

jess: it's the websocket integration that intermittently fails on GH runners (connect timeout). test name `test_streaming_response_timeout`. I added a short wait/retry in the skip PR. if CI-bot still fails we can revert and try matrix with smaller payloads.

pr-bot: matt pushed commit 7a3d2c7 to PR #312 — checks: golang-lint: passed, py-lint: passed, docs-build: pending.

ci-bot: GH Actions: workflow "docs-deploy" failed on job "render-site" — rerun triggered by sam at 12:18pm UTC.

sam: filed a tiny PR to mkdocs plugin that guards metadata (https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/889). it's a one-line fix + unit test. planning to land after a quick review.

anya: perfect. blockers: none for me. I'll consolidate the README changes and push a docs-only PR referencing matt's sampleapp changes. goal: merge docs PR + sampleapp PRs before EOD. if anyone needs help ping me. :rocket: 

matt: quick note — I updated the example to use the SDK v0.9 import path (`from redwood import RedwoodClient`). want ppl to eyeball before I rebase.

jess: ack, will review after I finish the flaky test skip. also adding a CI job to reproduce the mac runner flake locally via act.

anya: thanks all. tiny checklist for today: 1) matt — finalize env snippet, 2) sam — land mkdocs guard, 3) jess — monitor CI and revert skip if we can fix flake, 4) me — docs PR + merge coordination.

matt: noted, should be done ~3pm PT.

jess: i'll post status in this thread after CI rerun.

sam: landed the mkdocs guard and tests are green locally, will push once someone reviews.

anya: awesome — closing the loop: if anything becomes blocking, tag #devex and @anya. otherwise we'll do a short async sweep at 17:00 PT. :white_check_mark:
